name: Claude
description: General-purpose AI assistant for chat, writing, coding, file creation and web search, available on web, desktop and mobile.
research_notes: Fetched official Supported Regions Policy (effective 2026-11-12) and claude.com/pricing directly. The policy lists 185 supported countries; 'any country or region not listed is unsupported' and territories of listed countries are supported. countries_unavailable is derived: sovereign states/SARs absent from the list (computed against ISO 3166). Also unsupported per the page: Crimea, Donetsk, Kherson, Luhansk and Zaporizhzhia regions of Ukraine; and entities headquartered in or majority-controlled from unsupported regions. Not on the list and ambiguous: Cook Islands (CK), Niue (NU), Western Sahara (EH), Kosovo (no ISO code). Plans seen: Free $0, Pro $20/mo ($17/mo annual), Max $100, Ultra $200; prices shown in USD from this session's location, so local-currency pricing unknown. support.claude.com could not be fetched (blocked); iOS billing statement comes from a search snippet of the cited article. Phone-verification requirement and interface languages could not be confirmed. publisher_region left unknown: a search suggested HQ locations but no attributable source page could be fetched.

access.free_limits: Free plan: limited usage every 5 hours and every week; chat on web, desktop and mobile; web search, file creation, code execution; up to 5 projects; no Opus models.

value.note: Pricing page lists 'Credit card' for Pro, Max and Ultra; ACH and invoicing not offered on individual plans
Subscriptions started in the iOS app are billed and managed through the iOS device (per support article); Android billing not confirmed

name: ChatGPT
